Just Dance : Passion Meets Craft - The precision behind scoring
Passion Meets Craft explores the people, dedication and intent driving creativity around games. Today, through @littlesiha’s approach to scoring in Just Dance.

Scoring a perfect move isn't luck, it's craft. 🎯
For @Littlesiha, Just Dance has always been about precision as much as passion. She knows exactly what it takes to score big: timing, technique, and hours of practice.
In this newest episode of Passion Meets Craft with the Just Dance team, @Littlesiha breaks down her own approach to scoring, while the teams at Ubisoft behind Just Dance reveal just how much precision sits behind every point. Through the years, the game has had to keep pace with evolving consoles, with some systems being discontinued along the way, pushing the team to build its own camera scoring technology to keep that same precision alive, move for move. The team also works closely with choreographers on every map, making sure each move fits the song's difficulty and reads perfectly for the scoring system. Nothing here is left to chance, every move is measured.
Forty years into Ubisoft's journey, it's stories like this one that show creativity never stops, even behind the scenes.

ABOUT JUST DANCE 2026 EDITION:
#JustDance2026 Edition launches in October 2025!
Whether you're dancing solo, teaming up with friends or creating unforgettable memories with family, Just Dance 2026 Edition brings the fun with 40 fresh tracks from chart topping hits to timeless favorites!

Discover two exciting new ways to play: shake up your dance sessions with Party Mode, where unexpected twists keep the fun going, and enjoy full-body gameplay using your smartphone with the Camera Controller feature for a truly immersive experience!

Just Dance 2026 Edition has something for every mood and moment, with a vibrant mix of chart-topping hits, pop party anthems, timeless classics, viral sensations and more, including "APT." By ROSÉ & Bruno Mars, "Houdini" by Dua Lipa, "Counting Stars" by OneRepublic, "Hung Up" by Madonna, "All Star" by Smash Mouth and many more!
